description: This file defines React components for a tooltip UI element using the Radix UI library. It provides customizable Tooltip components with support for providers, triggers, content, and styling.

methods.name: TooltipProvider
methods.description: Provides a context for tooltips with optional delayDuration and other props.

methods.name: Tooltip
methods.description: Main wrapper component that incorporates the TooltipProvider around the Radix Tooltip Root.

methods.name: TooltipTrigger
methods.description: Component that acts as the element which triggers the display of the tooltip.

methods.name: TooltipContent
methods.description: Component that renders the tooltip content with styling, positioning, and an arrow.
